job: Tell the reader what happened and what to do, next to the content it is about.
purpose: A tinted message with an icon, a title, a short body and usually one action. It belongs to the content around it. Tone sets the meaning: neutral, accent, success, warning, danger, info, violet. It can be dismissed, and a dismissal can be remembered.
useWhen: A form or section needs a warning, a tip or a result right beside it.
An error has a cause and a next step the reader can take.
A limit is close: credits at 90%, crawl depth capped on the plan.

avoidWhen.when: The message affects the whole account and fits in one line.
The message confirms something that just happened and should fade away.
A field has an invalid value.
A list or table has nothing to show.

states.name: dismissed
states.how: data-fd-dismiss on a button; fires a cancelable fd:close and sets hidden

states.name: remembered
states.how: data-fd-dismiss-key="name" stores the dismissal in localStorage

variants.useWhen: Callout: something finished or is healthy.
Callout: something needs attention soon but is not broken.
Callout: something failed or is destructive.
Callout: one thing to notice, in the brand colour.
Callout: output from an agent or another special category.
Callout: plain information with no judgement; the default.
A single-line callout: title and text run together.

keyboard.does: On the dismiss button, hides the callout.
